blocks.note: sub-second tie on ttr_prime_s (sign depends on pairing rule: chainA +0.46 s hybrid-first; chainB -0.41 s reconcile-first)

relief_completion.note: slow-rate <=2pp window timing is definition-sensitive across five variants; direction splits (3/3, 4/2, etc.); keep the campaign tail gate (5/6) as the relief-completion criterion

mechanism_note: spawn->true-ready is arm-independent (12.6-13.4 s); the arm difference lives in true-ready->admit: hybrid fixed ~8 s (spawn->admit ~21 s via the 20 s fallback cadence), reconcile poll draw 0.4-7.7 s (spawn->admit 13.2-20.6 s)
